_readme: VO for the SLAPPING GROUNDS nature-doc trailer (tools/nature.js). Marks are placeholders — the assembler injects real output-time marks from the render's marks.json (shot starts by id + windup/contact/landing/replay stamps) before rendering voices. The narrator is an original Attenborough-STYLE parody character (posh nature-documentary register), NOT an impression of any real presenter. Mac flow: patch marks, then python3 tools/voice.py render <patched>.json --mix over the score bed.
name: nature-trailer

lines.text: Dawn... [beat 400] over the county.
The fair is waking. [beat 250] And so is its oldest industry.
Nature provides the corn. [beat 300] And the volunteers.
The large male. [beat 300] Known locally... as Charlie.
He has trained one arm. [beat 350] Only the one.
Observe. [beat 400] The coil.
He may hold it as long as he likes. [beat 250] No one has asked him to.
To explain what follows — [beat 200] the county's economists.
Thank you, sir. [beat 250] Folks. Watch the feet.
Here comes the wind-up —
[riff ooo_rise]
HE [emph]SLAPPED[/emph] HIM! [beat 250] THE ECONOMY IS [emph]SAVED[/emph]!
Every meter of that flight is a meter of G D P, Howie.
Hay futures are UP! Cheek futures are [rise]WAY UP[/rise]!
Doctors agree. One slap is cardio for the whole county.
DOWN at ninety-three meters! [beat 200] The market has landed!
We call that a soft correction.
The hips. [beat 300] The invisible hand... was a hand.
The county sleeps. [beat 350] The palm does not.
SlapMania dot org. [beat 250] The county thanks you for your cheek.
